Every parameter is a row of the data list's MIDI parameter change tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Parameter change: F0 43 1n 6B <address> <data> F7, n the device number (the deviceId variable is 1n, 10H for device number 1); bulk dumps are asked for with 2n and answered with 0n, both taken as device number 1.
No identity check: the data list prints the identity reply with the family bytes as `dd dd`, a code for each model (7C 04 for the MOTIF6, 7D 04 for the MOTIF7, 7E 04 for the MOTIF8).

Parameter changes at 40-42 (Normal Voice) and 46-47 (Drum Voice) edit the voice in the Voice mode's edit buffer; Pull asks for each edit buffer the Bulk Control table names, whichever mode the instrument is in.
The Plug-in Voice (4C) and the Plug-in Parts edit what a PLG board installed in the slot holds; without one their messages go unanswered.
Not asked for, holding no parameter laid out here: Plug-in Board Native System.
